title: SlaEvidence
description: Point-in-time payment-liveness SLA evidence overlay for Option A probe 200 (Architect packaging 2026-09-18 + CTO overlay align 2026-09-21). Not a warranty; after ttl_seconds treat as stale. Unsigned era: signer=none, signature=null. latency_pass omitted until a cited threshold exists.

observed_at.description: Seller clock ISO-8601 timestamp when the observation completed.

ttl_seconds.description: Freshness window in seconds. Live-Unlock lock default 300. After TTL buyer must treat evidence as stale (not pass).

status_class.description: Coarse liveness class derived from observed_status / abort.

signaling_shape.description: Pass-through probe rev1 payment-challenge signaling shape.

latency_ms.description: Measured RTT in milliseconds (report-only; no invented latency_pass threshold).

latency_pass.description: Optional. Whether latency met a cited seller threshold. Omit until CGO/CEO cite N — do not invent.

pass.description: Overall SLA pass for this observation (payment-liveness / 402-shape criteria — not uptime %).

abort_reason.description: Pass-through probe abort_reason; null if completed. No secrets.

signer.description: Who attests the observation. Use none while challenge-only / unsigned era.

signature.description: Optional detached proof. null while unsigned / no keys on box.

probe_ref.description: Optional correlation id for the paid probe call; null OK in docs era.
